user.title: Log in to Plejd
user.description: Use the account of the Plejd app. Your password is stored in Home Assistant and is used to refresh your device list about once a week. Control runs over Bluetooth.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Plejd again
reauth_confirm.description: Plejd did not accept the saved login. Enter your login again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Plejd cloud. Try again later.
error.site_not_found: This account does not have access to the configured site.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the log for details.

abort.bluetooth_not_available: At least one Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy is needed to use Plejd.
abort.no_sites: No Plejd sites were found for this account.

init.title: Bluetooth connection points
init.description: Home Assistant connects to your Plejd devices through one of the devices that run on mains power. Choose which of them may be used. Untick a device if its Bluetooth signal is weak or unstable.

abort.not_loaded: Plejd BLE is not running right now. Try again once the integration has started.
abort.no_gateways: No devices on mains power were found.

cloud_unreachable.title: Plejd cloud is not reachable
cloud_unreachable.description: The device list could not be refreshed from the Plejd cloud for more than seven days. Plejd BLE keeps working with the saved list. New or renamed devices only appear once the cloud is reachable again.

not_connected.message: There is no Bluetooth connection to the Plejd mesh right now.
